HTTP request wrapper for Twitch API calls that runs through the app's worker proxy, injects OAuth bearer tokens, and retries transient failures with exponential backoff. Search here for Twitch network reliability, 401 token refresh handling, 429 rate limiting, and health reporting via `recordPlatformSuccess` / `recordPlatformFailure`.

Resolves Twitch playback URLs for live streams, VODs, and clips using the public GQL client and constructs signed HLS/MP4 URLs for the player. This is the file to find Twitch media URL generation, clip quality selection, and the logging path for offline or failed playback resolution.

apps/desktop/src/backend/api/unified/slo.summary: Main-process SlotHost wrapper for a single StreamSlot, exposing lifecycle methods and dispatch helpers for loadStream, mute, quality, buffer config, and unload. Sits on top of slot-controller as the stable API seam for the renderer-OOM work, so callers do not change when the implementation later swaps from emitter-based dispatch to direct WebContentsView control.

Pure crash-retry decision function for slot recovery, with a 5-minute rolling window and a two-state outcome: silent retry on the first crash, retry affordance after repeated crashes. Useful to find the retry-threshold logic, unit-testable policy code, and the renderer-OOM crash-handling flow.

apps/desktop/src/backend/api/unified/sta.summary: Polling and parsing layer for Twitch and Kick status pages, normalizing status-page payloads into platform-health signals and details. Contains fetch selection for Electron vs Node, HTML/status string sanitization, Kick service/post extraction helpers, and the polling constants used by the platform-health monitor.

apps/desktop/src/backend/api/unified/web.summary: Injectable factory for Electron WebContentsView instances, with a hardened production configuration, lifecycle wrapper methods, render-process-gone wiring, and test reset hooks. Also exports URL/path resolvers for the slot renderer and preload bundle, making it the seam between slot-controller and the actual slot-hosted Chromium view.

apps/desktop/src/backend/api/unified/pla.summary: In-memory platform health state machine for Twitch/Kick API adapters, with rolling failure-rate detection, asymmetric degraded recovery, and a separate `down` burst detector for local `net::ERR_*` errors. Exports the health enums, thresholds, and record functions used by unified platform clients plus listener-based event emission for backoff and status reporting.

Defines the read-side contract every unified platform adapter implements, including paginated stream fetch options and the `IPlatformReader` interface. This is the seam for platform-specific readers that expose authentication checks and `getTopStreams` without wrapping errors in an envelope.

Shared normalized type layer for unified Twitch/Kick data models, covering streams, channels, categories, users, follows, chat messages, VODs, clips, search, pagination, and API responses. Search here for cross-platform normalization, Kick-specific chatroom settings, and the core `Unified*` export set consumed by backend and frontend features.

apps/desktop/src/backend/api/unified/reg.summary: Module-singleton registry for platform readers, letting adapters self-register at load time and be looked up by `Platform`. Exports the `clients` API for registering, retrieving, enumerating, and checking reader availability, which is the central routing point for unified platform adapter wiring.

apps/desktop/src/backend/api/unified/slo.summary: Main-process stream slot lifecycle controller and presence state machine, managing slot creation, focus/background/hidden presence, crash tracking, and optional WebContentsView-backed rendering. Exports slot management APIs plus background-quality and WCV toggles, and emits dispatch events like `set-mute`, `set-quality`, `set-buffer-config`, and `load-stream` to keep the multiview host and renderer in sync.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/AGENTS.md.summary: Auth module guide for the Electron desktop app's OAuth 2.1 login stack for Kick and Twitch. Documents the main auth flows, key files like `auth-window.ts`, `device-code-flow.ts`, and token exchange/refresh patterns, plus invariants such as PKCE, state validation, single-flight refresh, and Worker-backed client-secret handling.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/auth-windo.summary: Electron `BrowserWindow` manager for OAuth popups, including Kick's special two-phase sign-in flow and Twitch's direct authorization flow. Exports `AuthWindowManager`, session types, and the Kick header readiness predicate used to wait for DOM render before detecting login state.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/device-cod.summary: Twitch Device Code Grant flow implementation for devices or desktop flows that need out-of-band authorization. Exports `deviceCodeFlowService` plus request/poll methods that fetch device codes, poll the token endpoint with managed intervals, and report pending/authorized/expired states.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/index.ts.summary: Barrel export for the desktop auth backend, consolidating all authentication services, config helpers, and OAuth protocol/callback utilities into one import path. Search here for the main auth surface when wiring login, token refresh, PKCE/state generation, protocol handling, or platform-specific services for Twitch and Kick.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/kick-auth..summary: Kick-specific auth service for token refresh, logout/revocation cleanup, user lookup, and session-expiry handling in the desktop app. It coordinates storage, Kick scope validation, token exchange, and Electron cookie cleanup so Kick login state stays consistent across the app.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/kick-scope.summary: Small Kick scope validation helper that compares granted OAuth scopes against the app's required Kick scope list. Use this when you need to check whether a Kick token is canonical or identify missing permissions before refresh or API calls.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/oauth-call.summary: Local HTTP callback server used to capture OAuth redirects on `localhost`, with state verification and platform-specific success/failure responses. It solves the desktop OAuth callback problem for providers like Twitch that accept loopback redirects and exports callback result types plus the `oauthCallbackServer` instance.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/oauth-conf.summary: Central OAuth configuration for Twitch and Kick in the desktop auth backend. Exports the platform-specific client IDs, worker/token endpoints, PKCE helpers, redirect URI builder, and authorization URL construction used by the login/connect flow.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/protocol-h.summary: Electron custom-protocol handler for `streamfusion://` OAuth callbacks. Registers the OS protocol client, listens for `open-url` and second-instance events, parses callback codes/states/errors, and dispatches them to per-platform handlers.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/token-exch.summary: OAuth token exchange service for swapping auth codes for access tokens and refreshing credentials through the StreamFusion Worker. Exports typed request params plus `TokenRefreshError` so callers can distinguish retryable refresh failures from permanent auth invalidation.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/twitch-aut.summary: Twitch auth service for the desktop backend, handling token refresh, token revocation/logout, proactive refresh scheduling, and user-session invalidation when Twitch rejects credentials or required scopes are missing. Exports `TwitchAuthService` behavior through refresh and auth-lost callbacks, and fits into the broader auth pipeline alongside `storageService`, `token-exchange`, and the Twitch OAuth IPC flow.

apps/desktop/src/backend/auth/twitch-fol.summary: Credential helper for Twitch follow-write access using the device-code flow, including activation-window UI, polling, token validation, and cached credential reuse. Exports `TWITCH_FOLLOW_WRITE_CLIENT_ID`, `TwitchFollowWriteCredential`, and `TwitchFollowWriteCredentialService`, and it plugs into storage-backed auth for write-capable Twitch API calls.

apps/desktop/src/backend/context-menu.ts.summary: Electron right-click context menu builder for the main window, with a pure `buildContextMenuTemplate` helper and side-effecting `installContextMenu` wiring. It solves copy/paste behavior in editable areas while deliberately excluding auth popups and headless utility windows from the menu.

apps/desktop/src/backend/dev-relay/dev-m.summary: Security-filtered media relay for the desktop dev server. Exports the `DEV_MEDIA_PROXY_PATH`, URL validation/build helpers, HLS playlist rewriting, and `handleDevMediaProxyRequest`, which proxies only approved HTTPS media hosts, enforces range/size limits, follows a small redirect budget, and rewrites playlist URIs back through the local proxy.

apps/desktop/src/backend/dev-relay/dev-r.summary: Bootstraps the browser development relay only when the app is unpackaged and `STREAMFUSION_BROWSER_DEV=1`. Exports `startConfiguredDevRelay`, which validates the relay port, checks for the dev token and renderer origin, and delegates to the server factory so packaged builds do not expose the relay.

HTTP and WebSocket relay that connects a host and browser during local development. Exports `authorizeDevRelayUpgrade`, `startDevRelayServer`, and the relay types; it gates upgrades with a host/origin/token check, proxies authenticated media requests through the dev media proxy, and buffers messages between paired WebSocket peers.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/ad.summary: Registers the Electron IPC surface for ad blocking features: status, toggles, stats, cosmetic injection, Twitch manifest proxy cleanup, and VAFT pattern auto-update controls. This is the main renderer-to-main bridge for adblock/network filtering behavior, with handlers coordinating `networkAdBlockService`, `cosmeticInjectionService`, `twitchManifestProxy`, and `vaftPatternService`.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/ap.summary: Exposes a small `APP_GET_ENVIRONMENT` IPC endpoint that returns runtime metadata like dev mode, platform, and app/Electron/Node versions. Use this file when searching for environment detection, build-gating in the renderer, or version snapshots for bug reports.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/au.summary: Implements the auth IPC layer for login flows and post-login follow synchronization, including helper logic for Kick and Twitch follow import semantics. Key exports include `registerAuthHandlers`, `syncKickFollowsAfterLogin`, `persistInitialAuthToken`, and `shouldDeferKickStartupFollowRefresh`, plus constants and types for follow-sync outcomes and startup grace handling.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/bu.summary: Registers bug-report IPC handlers for writing markdown reports, opening the bug-report folder, listing recent reports, and exposing the report directory path. This file solves the end-to-end crash/issue capture flow by combining user description, app metadata, and log tails into timestamped files with sender-origin checks.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/ca.summary: IPC bridge for category lookup across Twitch and Kick, exposing top-category fetch, category-by-id, metadata tags, and search endpoints to the renderer. It dynamically imports platform clients, returns `{ success, data }` envelopes, and leaves de-duplication and Twitch/Kick merging rules to the frontend `useCategories` hook.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/ch.summary: IPC handlers for resolving channels by ID or username and for loading followed channels from Twitch auth or local Kick follow storage. It includes Kick-specific slug repair and self-channel enrichment logic so the renderer gets corrected usernames, avatars, and profile data for the logged-in Kick account.

Small IPC guard for subscriber-chat eligibility checks, validating the sender origin before delegating to the backend subscriber eligibility service. Use this file when searching for chat permission gates, IPC origin checks, or subscriber-only chat gating.

IPC layer for chat-related data fetches, including Kick and Twitch chat history seeding, Twitch badge catalog loading, pinned-message lookup, and mention-user enrichment/caching. It centralizes chat bootstrap logic, platform-specific endpoint calls, and helper utilities for deduping users and generating default Kick avatars.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/lo.summary: IPC bridge for renderer-to-main logging and log viewer utilities, including write forwarding, opening the log folder, resolving current/noise/network log paths, and tailing log files with level/tag/query filters. Exports `registerLogHandlers`, which enforces sender-origin checks and mirrors the renderer's log line classification for the Settings > Logs panel.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/mo.summary: IPC handlers for moderation history persistence and retention settings, wrapping database inserts, queries, and retention sweeps behind sender checks and moderation authorization. Exports `registerModLogHandlers`, which enforces platform/provenance validation for Twitch and Kick mod-log entries and returns structured query states like verified-empty, partial, and ready.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/pl.summary: IPC bridge for platform health snapshots and live health-change broadcasts, used to hydrate the renderer and push status transitions from the main process. Exports `registerPlatformHealthHandlers`, which also clears Kick stream failure caches when recovery is detected and logs IPC health events.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/pr.summary: IPC handlers for applying proxy settings and storing encrypted proxy credentials from the renderer, plus an advisory read for whether credentials exist. Exports `registerProxyHandlers` and `applyPersistedProxyOnStart`, combining sender-origin validation with startup reapplication of saved proxy preferences through the stream proxy service.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/ch.summary: IPC bridge for loading and cancelling Chat Replay windows from the main process. It validates Twitch/Kick replay requests, deduplicates by `requestId`, and uses `AbortController` to cancel stale `loadWindow` calls from the `ChatReplayService`.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/do.summary: Registers Electron IPC endpoints for the desktop download queue, wiring renderer requests to queue, clip download, video download, and file action services. This is the central handler for enqueue/pause/resume/cancel/retry/remove/open/show-in-folder/delete workflows and queue-change broadcasts.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/em.summary: Electron IPC registration for fetching emote data from 7TV, BTTV, FFZ, and Kick services. It exposes renderer-facing handlers for global sets, user/channel lookups, and Kick subscription queries through the shared IPC channel map.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/ki.summary: Main-process IPC boundary for Kick chat moderation and messaging actions such as send, ban, timeout, unban, delete, pin, and unpin. It guards sensitive web mutations with sender-origin checks and logs each request/result so the renderer does not import the heavy Kick send-window stack directly.

Thin re-export barrel for Kick follow metadata repair utilities. It exposes helpers for scanning slugs, parsing broadcaster IDs, repairing follow records, and resolving playback slugs so IPC code can reach the shared repair logic without duplicating imports.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/lo.summary: IPC handlers for the local captioning feature, bridging the renderer to model download state and the caption supervisor. It validates session identity, enforces application-renderer sender checks, streams model-state updates, and controls caption session start/stop and PCM audio push.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/se.summary: IPC search handlers for desktop channel lookup and enrichment, with cache-backed validation of Twitch and Kick search results. Defines helper filters like `isValidChannel` plus platform-specific verification flows that fetch fresh avatars, display names, follower counts, and existence checks before returning search results to the renderer.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/sl.summary: Main-process IPC bridge for the slot-controller state machine, wiring host commands like focus, multiview cap, retry, create/destroy, load-stream, and bounds updates into unified slot controller APIs. Also fans slot events back to the correct WebContentsView or host window, making it the primary search target for slot lifecycle, WCV routing, and crash-recovery IPC.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/st.summary: IPC storage layer for generic key-value persistence, local follows, and user preferences in the desktop app. Exposes getters/setters plus follow-management routes like add/remove/import/update/is-following, and contains platform-specific Kick follow repair and source-tracking logic for guest vs authenticated writes.

Registers IPC handlers for stream browsing and discovery across Twitch and Kick, including top streams, category streams, and followed streams with cross-platform merge/sort behavior. Exports `registerStreamHandlers`, plus Kick startup scan helpers used to control follow-scan timing during app boot.

Registers renderer-safe IPC endpoints for stream recording lifecycle actions such as start, stop, pause, resume, recovery, and UI state queries. Exports `registerStreamRecordingHandlers` and uses request validation plus sender-origin checks to bridge the recording service into the Electron main process.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/sy.summary: Provides core system IPC handlers for app metadata, window controls, theme detection, external links, and desktop notifications. Exports `registerSystemHandlers` and acts as the main Electron bridge for app shell actions and safe renderer communication.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/ti.summary: Registers moderation IPC handlers for creating timeout snapshots and submitting timeout actions to Twitch and Kick with schema validation and sender authorization. Exports `registerTimeoutModerationHandlers` and wires platform adapters into the timeout moderation service while persisting successful actions to the local mod log.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/to.summary: IPC handler for the Settings API/Tokens panel that reports token connectivity and validation state for Twitch and Kick without ever exposing the token value across IPC. Exports `registerTokenStatusHandlers`, which checks sender origin, reads stored tokens, and returns a strict `TokenStatusResult` with login, userId, scopes, and expiry metadata.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/up.summary: Electron IPC bridge for app auto-update actions such as check, download, install, status, and update preferences. Exports `registerUpdateHandlers(mainWindow)`, validates payloads defensively, wraps service failures into structured error responses, and initializes the update service after handlers are registered.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/us.summary: IPC handlers for resolving public Twitch and Kick profile data, account-created dates, follow relationships, and channel lookup results. Exports `registerUserProfileHandlers` and a `readWithDevelopmentFixture` helper that swaps in dev fixtures based on sender URL query parameters when the app is unpackaged.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/vi.summary: Clip and video helper module for Twitch and Kick that powers channel clip fetching, pagination cutoff logic, deduping, and time-range filtering. Exports `getCutoffMs`, `fillPageWithCutoff`, `handleGetClipsByChannel`, and related types used by the video browser UI and stream resolvers.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/handlers/wr.summary: Small IPC wrapper that standardizes handler responses into `{ success, data }` or `{ success, error }` envelopes. Exports `wrapHandler` and `HandlerResult` so backend IPC routes can reuse consistent try/catch error mapping without repeating boilerplate.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc/sender-orig.summary: Electron IPC sender-origin guard for security-sensitive `ipcMain.handle` paths. Exports `isAllowedSenderUrl` and `isAllowedSender` to block privileged IPC from any renderer origin except the app bundle in production or loopback dev servers, which is used as a mitigation when `webSecurity: false` is enabled.

apps/desktop/src/backend/ipc-handlers.ts.summary: Main-process IPC bootstrap that registers the full set of renderer-to-backend handlers in one place. Exports `registerIpcHandlers(mainWindow)` and wires auth, storage, stream, logs, proxy, updates, bug reports, and slot-controller setup together at startup.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/chromiu.summary: File tailer that forwards Chromium native log output into the app logger by polling the `--log-file` path. Exports `startChromiumLogTailer`, tracks append-only reads across rotations, and maps Chromium severity lines into structured logger levels while filtering noise.

Predicate module for classifying known-harmless Chromium log lines so the logging pipeline can demote them from errors to debug. Exports `isHarmlessChromiumNoise`, covering GPU probe failures, Autofill stubs, cache cleanup chatter, SSL resets, and dev-server banners.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/console.summary: Global console patch that routes `console.log/info/warn/error/debug` through the structured logger without forcing a large call-site migration. Exports `installConsoleIntercept`, preserves original methods for safe uninstall/fallback, and is designed to avoid recursion with electron-log.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/crash-h.summary: Crash and process-failure hook installer for Electron and Node that records fatal events before the app exits. Exports `installCrashHooks`, attaching listeners for uncaught exceptions, unhandled rejections, render-process-gone, and child-process-gone so failures land in the session log.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/log-pat.summary: Resolves the on-disk locations for app logs, bug reports, and telemetry across dev, Windows packaged builds, and read-only macOS/Linux installs. Exports `computeLogPaths`, `setBugReportsDir`/`getBugReportsDir`, and `setTelemetryDir`/`getTelemetryDir`, and is the shared path-policy module used by main-process startup and IPC handlers.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/logger..summary: Main-process logging wrapper around `electron-log` that formats each line as a structured `[timestamp] [level] [tag] message` entry and writes a session-specific log file. Exports the `logger` singleton plus `initLogger`, `shutdownLogger`, `getCurrentLogPath`, `formatLine`, and sink hooks for side-channel log consumers.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/native-.summary: Patches `process.stdout.write` and `process.stderr.write` so native Chromium/Electron output is mirrored into the app logger without suppressing terminal output. Exports `installNativeStderrIntercept`, and is the bridge for capturing console noise, Chromium ERROR/WARNING/INFO lines, and avoiding recursive logger writes.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/network.summary: Listens to Electron DevTools Protocol `Network.requestWillBeSent` events and records network-request hints with source-mapped initiator locations. Exports `installNetworkDevtoolsRecorder`, and plugs DevTools network tracing into the app's network diagnostics pipeline.

Routes general log sink entries into the dedicated `networkLogger` when tags or message text match network-related patterns like manifests, stream resolvers, outages, and Chromium networking errors. Exports `installNetworkLogRouter`, which connects the main logger to the network-specific logging channel.

File-scoped Electron side-channel logger for network diagnostics, writing `streamfusion-network-<stamp>.log` and a pointer file so stream-load, WebRTC/TURN, manifest, status-page, and websocket issues can be inspected separately from the main session log. Exports the `networkLogger` implementation plus `initNetworkLogger`, `getCurrentNetworkPath`, and `shutdownNetworkLogger` for lifecycle-controlled file logging with configurable levels.

Network request instrumentation for Electron `Session` traffic, classifying stream/media requests, redacting URLs, hashing fingerprints, and correlating request starts with DevTools initiator hints. Exports helpers like `networkRequestUrlFingerprint`, `isNetworkStreamRequestUrl`, and `recordDevtoolsNetworkRequestHint`, and underpins the request-tracking path used to debug HLS/WebSocket/media delivery issues.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/noise-l.summary: Separate Electron side-channel logger for high-volume noise events such as HLS segments, player ticks, and chat-stream throughput, keeping them out of the main session log. Exports `noiseLogger`, `initNoiseLogger`, `getCurrentNoisePath`, and `shutdownNoiseLogger`, with its own file transport, log-level controls, and pointer file for easier debugging.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/platfor.summary: Boot-time telemetry sink that listens for platform health changes and appends JSONL records to `platform-health.jsonl` under the telemetry directory. It tracks previous state per platform and logs transition metadata for kick/twitch health monitoring, using the shared logger only for write failures.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/process.summary: Process-wide resource sampler for Electron main process logging, emitting a grep-stable `ProcessMonitor` line with RSS, heap, CPU, load average, and per-process `app.getAppMetrics()` data. Exports `formatSnapshot`, `formatProcessMetrics`, and `startProcessMonitor`, and is used as the shared interval-based telemetry hook for backend diagnostics.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/redacto.summary: Pure redaction layer that strips secrets from log strings and object graphs before anything hits disk, covering bearer tokens, OAuth callback codes, JWTs, and sensitive JSON/object keys. Exports `redactString` and `redactObject`, and sits as the last defense in the logger pipeline for bug-report-safe logs.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/rotatio.summary: Log retention helper that scans a directory for prefixed `.log` files, keeps the newest N by mtime, and deletes older files with best-effort error handling. Exports `pruneLogs` along with `PruneOptions` and `PruneResult`, and is used to keep desktop log storage bounded.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/source-.summary: Source-map lookup utility that maps runtime script locations back to original TypeScript/webpack sources using cached `trace-mapping` data. Exports `resolveSourceMappedLocation`, which resolves stack-trace or error locations into human-readable source URLs and display labels for diagnostics.

apps/desktop/src/backend/logging/web-con.summary: Electron `WebContents` console bridge that forwards warning and error messages from all frames into the project logger, including older and newer `console-message` event shapes. Exports `forwardWebContentsConsole`, and filters known noisy third-party messages so session logs stay actionable.

apps/desktop/src/backend/protocols/image.summary: Bounded in-memory cache for custom image protocol responses in the Electron main process, avoiding repeated CDN fetches for thumbnails and other remote images. Exports the singleton `imageByteCache` plus `resetImageByteCacheForTests`, and implements TTL-based LRU-style eviction by entry count and total bytes.

apps/desktop/src/backend/protocols/kick-.summary: Electron `kick-image://` protocol handler that replaces base64 image IPC with streamed image fetches so Chromium can use its native image cache for Kick CDN thumbnails. Key exports are `KICK_IMAGE_SCHEME` and `registerKickImageProtocol`, with helper logic for building/decoding encoded image URLs and serving a 1x1 PNG placeholder on failures.

apps/desktop/src/backend/protocols/twitc.summary: Electron `twitch-clip-media://` protocol for playing Twitch clip MP4s through the main process, preserving Range requests and supplying stable headers when Chromium rejects direct signed CDN URLs. Exports `handleTwitchClipMediaRequest` for testable request handling and `registerTwitchClipMediaProtocol` to attach the protocol handler.

Shared URL utility for the Twitch clip media protocol that base64url-encodes and decodes upstream clip URLs into the `twitch-clip-media://` scheme format. Exports `TWITCH_CLIP_MEDIA_SCHEME`, `buildTwitchClipMediaUrl`, and `decodeTwitchClipMediaUrl` for renderer/main-process coordination.

Electron `twitch-image://` protocol that proxies Twitch profile-image CDN requests through the main process and falls back to a transparent 1x1 PNG when the upstream returns errors or non-image content. Key export is `registerTwitchImageProtocol`, with internal helpers for URL encoding/decoding and placeholder responses used to suppress renderer console noise.

apps/desktop/src/backend/recovery/render.summary: Renderer crash-recovery hook for Electron host windows that listens to `render-process-gone` and reloads the current URL when the renderer dies from recoverable reasons like OOM or forced kill. Exports `installRendererCrashRecovery`, which returns an uninstall function and logs recovery events through the backend logger.

apps/desktop/src/backend/search/progress.summary: Thin adapter that turns the generic progressive recent-content search pipeline into a clip-specific search implementation. Exports clip search types plus `createProgressiveClipSearch`, wiring clip fetching into shared ranking/deduplication logic with the `Clip` label.

Core progressive search engine for recent content across channels and content pages, handling session state, pagination, concurrency limits, cancellation, and rate-limit retries. Exports the request/page/profile/source types and `createProgressiveRecentContentSearch`, which collects channels, fans out content fetches, ranks/deduplicates results, and returns cursor-based pages.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/captio.summary: Manages local caption model installation, verification, and recovery for Electron desktop captions, including staged downloads, resumable file fetches, SHA-256 integrity checks, and rollback-safe activation. Exports `LocalCaptionModelStore` plus integrity error types and listener/options interfaces used by the caption runtime and supervisor.

Spawns the isolated Electron utility process that runs the local caption recognizer bundle, while filtering environment variables down to a safe runtime set. Exports `captionUtilityEnvironment` and `spawnCaptionUtilityProcess`, which the caption runtime uses to launch the audio-recognition worker.

Wraps the Sherpa online recognizer stream to turn PCM chunks into caption results, acknowledgements, cue IDs, revisions, and timestamped words. Exports `LocalCaptionRecognizer`, which the supervisor feeds audio into and which handles endpointing, stream resets, and incremental transcript updates.

Coordinates the singleton local-caption runtime for the main Electron window by wiring together the model store and supervisor, then forwarding results and recognizer state over IPC. Exports `getLocalCaptionRuntime` and `disposeLocalCaptionRuntime`, which act as the backend entry point for desktop local captions.

Supervises the utility-process caption worker lifecycle, enforcing session/generation ownership, in-flight audio backpressure, and message validation for ack/result/state traffic. Exports `LocalCaptionSupervisor`, `CaptionUtilityProcess`, and lease types used to start, stop, and recover local transcription sessions.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/cert-v.summary: Installs a diagnostic Electron certificate verification hook that logs hostname, error code, and verification metadata whenever TLS validation fails, while still deferring to the platform verifier. Exports `registerCertVerifyDiag` and `attachCertVerifyDiagToAllSessions`, used to attach cert debugging to default and newly created sessions.

apps/desktop/src/backend/search/progress.summary: Progressive, budget-aware stream search orchestrator for live platform directories, combining native search results with paginated directory crawling, deduping, ranking, retry-after handling, and session-scoped continuation cursors. Exports the `createProgressiveStreamSearch` API plus budget/profile types, concurrency helpers, and failure-progress tracking used by the desktop search pipeline.

Adapter that builds progressive video search on top of the shared recent-content search engine, wiring channel discovery, per-channel video fetching, and video-specific ranking/deduplication. This is the thin composition layer to find when tracing how desktop video search reuses the generic recent-content search machinery.

apps/desktop/src/backend/search/search-m.summary: Central search matching contract for channels, streams, videos, and clips, providing normalization re-exports plus fuzzy ranking helpers and deduplication filters. Developers will find the token normalization, one-edit Damerau matching, and tiered match scoring logic that drives search relevance and sorting across content types here.

apps/desktop/src/backend/search/search-r.summary: Small request-budget contract for search flows, defining the consumer callback used to count upstream requests and the error type used when search budgets are exhausted. This is the file to inspect when search code needs to enforce request limits or detect budget failures.

apps/desktop/src/backend/search/search-s.summary: AbortController-backed search session registry that tracks leases, cancels active searches, and cleans up session state when the last consumer releases it. It defines the shared session lifecycle primitives used across search features to coordinate cancellation and detect aborted sessions.

apps/desktop/src/backend/search/stream-s.summary: Calibrated runtime budget profile for stream directory search, mapping each platform to page size, max pages, request caps, timeout, and concurrency limits. Search this when adjusting Twitch or Kick stream crawling behavior or understanding the current operational limits for progressive stream search.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/captio.summary: Catalog of local caption model packs, currently defining the bundled English Zipformer ONNX model from Hugging Face with file hashes, sizes, URLs, and licensing metadata. This is the lookup point for caption model download/install logic and for anything that needs the canonical model artifact list.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/chat/A.summary: Project guide for the chat backend service layer, listing the Twitch and Kick service files, their responsibilities, and the invariants around reconnects, badge loading, room-state patches, predictions, and emote enrichment. Use this as the entry point when searching for chat connection lifecycle, parser contracts, cache rules, or platform boundaries between renderer, IPC, and auth.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/chat/b.summary: Twitch badge resolution and caching service that fetches global and channel badge catalogs, transforms API/GQL responses into shared chat badge types, and memoizes resolved badge arrays for chat rendering performance. Look here for badge lookup, cache invalidation, catalog hydration, and the cross-logger pattern used to keep Electron code out of the renderer bundle.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/chat/k.summary: Kick chat connection service built on Pusher WebSocket plus renderer-to-main IPC for sending messages through the hidden send window. It owns Kick chat lifecycle concerns like parsing messages and badges, pin normalization, reconnect/leave handling, and typed event emission into the shared chat store and UI.

Parser and type adapter for Kick Pusher WebSocket chat traffic. Exports Kick event payload types plus helpers like `parseKickBadges()` that convert Kick messages, badges, avatars, mentions, emotes, and moderation events into the shared `ChatMessage`/`ChatBadge` model used by the desktop chat pipeline.

Normalizes raw Kick prediction payloads from Pusher and REST seed responses into the platform-agnostic `UnifiedPrediction` shape. Exports `normalizeKickPrediction()` and option types, clamping status values, mapping outcomes, and synthesizing timestamps for the `PredictionBanner` widget.

Ref-counted singleton service that owns Kick prediction subscriptions and REST seeding for a channel. Exports `KickPredictionsChannelInfo` and the service lifecycle methods to acquire/release `predictions-channel-{id}`, normalize updates, and emit `predictionUpdate` through `kickChatService` for live UI consumption.

Pure translator from Kick chatroom update payloads into internal room-state patches. Exports `KickChatroomUpdatedEventPayload` and `chatroomUpdatedEventToPatch()`, mapping Kick slow mode, followers-only, subs-only, emote-only, and account-age restrictions into `RoomStatePatchEvent` fields.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/chat/s.summary: Subscriber eligibility checker for chat platforms, with parsing helpers for Kick subscription payloads and a Twitch Helix subscription lookup that validates OAuth scopes before deciding subscribed, notSubscribed, missingScopes, or unknown. Exports `parseKickSubscriberEligibility`, `checkKickSubscriberEligibility`, `checkTwitchSubscriberEligibility`, and `checkSubscriberEligibility`, and fits into chat moderation/feature-gating flows that need to know whether a viewer is subscribed to the current channel.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/chat/t.summary: Client-side emote substitution helper that scans parsed chat text fragments and replaces matching emote names with emote fragments, preserving whitespace and non-text fragments. Exports `substituteThirdPartyEmotes`, and is used in chat rendering to resolve third-party emotes like 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ, with an optional mode for native Twitch/Kick emotes on self-echo paths.

Twitch IRC chat service built on `tmi.js` that manages connection lifecycle, reconnects, rate limiting, identity, and event emission for chat messages and room-state updates. Exports the `TwitchChatService` class, which sits at the center of Twitch chat transport, using parser/resolver modules for badges, emotes, notices, and connection-state tracking.

WebSocket client for Twitch Hermes prediction events, reverse-engineered from Twitch's post-PubSub channel and used to subscribe anonymously to `predictions-channel-v1.<channelId>` updates. Exports `TwitchHermesClient`, which manages connect/reconnect state, keepalive watchdogs, deduped frame handling, and emits parsed `UnifiedPrediction` events into the chat service layer.

Low-level IRC wire parser for Twitch chat lines from `recent-messages.robotty.de`, converting raw IRCv3 strings into the `ParsedTwitchIrcLine` shape consumed by the higher-level Twitch message parser. Exports `parseRawTwitchIrcLine` and handles tag decoding, badge/emote parsing, ACTION messages, and display-name backfilling for PRIVMSG and USERNOTICE events.

Core Twitch chat message parser that turns tmi.js-style tags and message text into the project's unified `ChatMessage` model. Exports helpers like `getDefaultColor` and `parseBadgeTags`, and contains the emote, mention, link, and reply parsing logic used by the Twitch chat backend.

Polls Twitch's GraphQL pinned-chat API on an interval and bridges pin updates into normalized `pinnedMessage` / `pinnedMessageCleared` events for the shared chat service. Contains the URL-fragment parser, pin signature diffing, and start/stop/reset polling controls used to keep the Twitch pin banner in sync with live channel state.

Translates tmi.js `roomstate` tags and moderation notice IDs into partial room-state patches for Twitch chat. Exports the `roomStateTagsToPatch` and `noticeMsgIdToRoomStatePatch` helpers, isolating followers-only, slow mode, emote-only, subs-only, and verification-state parsing for unit tests.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/chat-r.summary: Coordinates chat replay loading across Twitch and Kick, adding pagination, duplicate suppression, safety limits, and a centered time window around the requested offset. Exports `createChatReplayService` plus the default `chatReplayService`, which adapts platform-specific replay fetchers into a shared `loadWindow` API.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/clip-d.summary: Builds the default clip download workflow for Electron, wiring platform playback resolution, quality selection, save dialogs, collision-safe destination paths, and either direct-file or ffmpeg HLS downloads. Exports `getDefaultClipDownloadService`, which assembles the default `ClipDownloadService` used by the desktop app.

Orchestrates Twitch clip downloads by resolving playback metadata, selecting quality, choosing save paths, and dispatching either direct MP4 downloads or HLS/ffmpeg downloads. It exports the clip download service interface plus helpers like `unwrapClipDownloadUrl`, retry/error classification, and quality matching logic used by the download queue and playback resolver.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/cosmet.summary: Electron WebContents injection service that hides Twitch ad UI with CSS and scriptlets, using a Ghostery-style pattern to block ad-related globals before they run. Exports a singleton `cosmeticInjectionService` with enable/disable and window/WebContents injection methods for the app's adblocking pipeline.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/databa.summary: SQLite persistence layer for the desktop app, bootstrapping the user-data database, enabling WAL mode, and migrating tables for follows and mod-log data. It exports `DatabaseService` plus re-exported mod-log types, and contains schema/provenance logic for local follows, sync-backed account follows, and retention-aware logging.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/direct.summary: Low-level direct file download helper that streams a remote file to disk with progress callbacks, temp-file cleanup, and abort-aware cancellation handling. Exports `DownloadCancelledError`, `FetchFile`, and `downloadDirectFile`, and is used as the MP4 path beneath the clip download service.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/downlo.summary: Electron main-process service for download item actions like show in folder, open file, remove from list, and delete from disk. Exports `DownloadFileActionsService`, `createDownloadFileActionsService`, and `getDefaultDownloadFileActionsService`, wiring queue lookups, file existence checks, confirmation dialogs, and shell/file-system operations into a testable action layer.

Filename and destination-path helper for downloads, handling Windows-safe sanitization, reserved DOS names, extension normalization, and collision avoidance. Exports `buildDownloadFilename` and `getAvailableDestinationPath`, which are used when deriving stable output paths for downloaded media.

Stateful download queue manager for the Electron backend, providing enqueue/start/pause/resume/cancel/retry/complete/fail/update/remove operations with persistence and subscriber notifications. Exports `createDownloadQueueService` and `getDownloadQueueService`, and normalizes hydrated jobs after app restart so active downloads reopen as paused.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/emotes.summary: Main-process 7TV REST bridge that fetches user connections and the global emote set with Electron `net.fetch`, converting 404s into `null` for renderer safety. Exports `fetch7TVUserByConnection` and `fetch7TVGlobalEmoteSet`, supporting the renderer-side emote provider without exposing noisy 404s in DevTools.

Renderer-side 7TV emote provider that fetches global, channel, and emote-set data, preferring the main-process IPC bridge and falling back to direct HTTP when needed. Implements the `EmoteProviderService` contract, includes 7TV-specific URL/format helpers, and logs failures while hiding expected 404 behavior for missing linked accounts.

Developer guide for the emote service layer under `backend/services/emotes`, explaining the provider architecture, cache/LRU rules, and how `emoteManager` is used for lookup, search, and text parsing. Useful when searching for Twitch/Kick/BTTV/FFZ/7TV integration, provider registration, single-flight loading, or emote cache invariants.

Main-process BTTV fetch helpers using Electron `net.fetch` so 404s for empty Twitch emote sets stay out of renderer DevTools. Exports `fetchBTTVGlobalEmotes` and `fetchBTTVUserByTwitchId` for the renderer-side BTTV provider’s IPC-backed data loading.

Renderer-side BetterTTV provider implementation that conforms to `EmoteProviderService` and normalizes BTTV global and Twitch channel emotes into the shared `Emote` shape. Exports the `bttvEmoteProvider` singleton and provider class, with Twitch-only gating, CDN URL building, and error logging.

Central emote orchestration layer that registers providers, loads global and channel emotes, applies platform/provider routing, and maintains cache, TTL cleanup, and LRU eviction. Key search terms are `emoteManager`, single-flight deduplication, `PLATFORM_PROVIDERS`, and cache keys for Twitch/Kick emote loading.

Shared type definitions for the emote system, including `Emote`, `EmoteSet`, `EmoteProvider`, `EmoteProviderService`, and manager config defaults. This is the file to find for emote shape contracts, provider interface requirements, Kick/7TV metadata fields, and cache configuration constants.

Main-process FrankerFaceZ REST client for Electron, using `net.fetch` to load global sets and channel room data with 404-as-null behavior. This is the backend transport layer for FFZ emote ingestion and is paired with the renderer-side FFZ provider.

Renderer-side FFZ emote provider that converts FFZ API payloads into the project’s normalized `Emote` shape, including animated URLs, owner metadata, and Twitch-only channel lookups. Exports the `ffzEmoteProvider` singleton plus `FFZEmoteProvider` for tests, and fits into the shared emote manager/provider system.

Central emote-service barrel that re-exports the emote manager and shared types, then registers Twitch, Kick, BTTV, FFZ, and 7TV providers behind an idempotent initializer. Also exposes provider-specific configuration helpers for Twitch credentials and Kick access tokens.

Main-process Kick web fetcher for channel emotes, probing Kick’s legacy `/emotes/{slug}` and `/api/v1/channels/{slug}` endpoints with timeout, header, and 404 handling. It returns raw payloads for the renderer/provider bridge and avoids noisy DevTools network errors for expected missing channels.

Renderer-side Kick emote provider that normalizes Kick API and web-session payloads into `Emote` objects, including channel emotes, subscriber emotes, and URL generation. Exports `KickEmoteProvider` and integrates with the emote manager via the shared provider interface and optional Electron bridge services.

Main-process helper that reads the signed-in user’s Kick subscriptions from the hidden web session via `/api/v2/user/subscriptions` and parses the JSON response. This powers subscriber emote discovery when the public Kick API does not expose the inventory directly.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/kick-f.summary: Background refresh loop for Kick follow metadata, combining an immediate startup pass with a managed interval and deduplicated in-flight execution. Exports `refreshKickFollowMetadataNow`, `startKickFollowMetadataRefresh`, and `stopKickFollowMetadataRefresh`, and it drives slug repair for locally stored Kick follows via storage and the Kick API client.

Slug and profile metadata repair utilities for Kick follows, used to resolve stale local follow records back to canonical channel data. Exports `parseKickBroadcasterUserId`, `repairKickFollowSlugs`, `getKickFollowScanSlugs`, and `resolveKickFollowPlaybackSlug`, and it updates storage when channel IDs, usernames, display names, or avatars have drifted.

Stateful follow/unfollow write coordinator for Kick that queues pending actions, calls the remote follow endpoints, syncs the account's followed channels, and retries or pauses on auth and transient errors. The `KickFollowWriteService` class centralizes pending-write lifecycle management, confirmation checks, retry backoff, and resuming timers after restart.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/kick-l.summary: Polling source for Kick live notifications that fetches public streams for followed channels with concurrency limits and staggered requests. Exports `KickLiveNotificationSource` and its relay event type, and it deduplicates follows by slug while preserving the last known live stream for fallback during API failures.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/live-n.summary: Polls Twitch and Kick sources for live channels, tracks per-channel online state, and emits in-app or desktop live notifications when a followed channel goes live. Also computes live-notification coverage status and records degraded polling/desktop-permission issues, making this the main service to search for live alert orchestration, follow matching, and notification eligibility logic.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/mod-lo.summary: Renderer-side mod-action ingestion service that deduplicates moderation events from EventSub, IRC, local callbacks, Kick pusher events, and Helix bootstrap data before writing to the `mod_log` SQLite table over IPC. Key exports are the `ModLogAction`/`ModLogSource` types, `RecordModActionInput`, and the `ModLogWriter` singleton methods for initialization, recording, and EventSub translation, so search here for moderation audit logging and cross-source deduping.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/modera.summary: Factory for a timeout workflow that first snapshots and verifies the target state, then revalidates before executing the timeout to prevent stale or unauthorized moderation actions. Exports timeout binding/policy aliases plus `createTimeoutModerationService`, which returns snapshot creation, timeout submission, and test accessors for the retry/revalidation state machine.

Authorization gate for viewing moderation history on Twitch and Kick, deciding whether the current user is a broadcaster or moderator or should be denied as guest, viewer, missing-scopes, or unverified. Exports `authorizeModerationHistory` plus the authorization types, and it ties together stored tokens, live token validation, OAuth scope checks, channel identity verification, and platform-specific moderator lookups.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/networ.summary: Electron-session network blocker that filters Twitch ad, telemetry, analytics, and tracking requests using regex rules before they reach the app. Exports a singleton `networkAdBlockService` with enable/disable/toggle controls and block statistics, making it the central ad-blocking layer for request interception and diagnostics.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/storag.summary: Persistent storage layer for auth tokens, app preferences, window state, and local follows, using `electron-store` plus Electron `safeStorage` encryption for secrets. The visible API includes token save/load/clear helpers, expiry checks, preference hydration, and startup initialization, making this the main backend state-and-credentials service.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/stream.summary: Main-process Twitch stream proxy manager that applies a user-configurable HTTP/HTTPS proxy to Electron's `defaultSession`, handles proxy-auth login challenges, and safely clears back to direct egress when disabled or invalid. Key exports include `applyProxy`, plus internal helpers for encrypted credential storage and proxy rule construction; it fits into the desktop app's streaming pipeline alongside stream fetching and session-level networking.

FFmpeg-based probe for checking whether a recorded stream artifact is non-empty and decodable before treating it as a usable recording. It exports `createStreamRecordingArtifactProbe` and the `StreamRecordingArtifactProbe` type, and is used as a validation step in the recording flow to distinguish real media files from empty or broken outputs.

Wires together the default desktop stream-recording workflow by composing resolvers, ffmpeg download/start logic, quality selection, save-path prompts, and outcome delivery into a singleton `StreamRecordingService`. The main export `getDefaultStreamRecordingService` is the integration point between platform resolvers (Twitch/Kick), Electron dialogs/notifications, filesystem helpers, and the lower-level recording service.

Coordinates how finished recording notices are delivered, persisted, dismissed, and opened, including in-app banners, native notifications, and ownership checks before revealing files. The main export `createStreamRecordingOutcomeCoordinator` ties session-store state to UI actions like open/show/dismiss, making it the notification and post-save control layer for stream recordings.

Path and identity utilities for stream recording outputs and segment files, including safe session IDs, normalized `.mp4` destinations, owned `.ts` fallback paths, and symlink/availability checks. It exports helpers like `normalizeRecordingDestination`, `createOwnedRecordingSectionPath`, `isOwnedRecordingOutput`, and `isRecordingSectionAvailable`, and is used to keep recording artifacts predictable and secure on disk.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/emotes.summary: Twitch Helix emote provider for the desktop emotes pipeline, handling global emotes, channel emotes, emote sets, and user emotes with token refresh and scope checks. Exports the `twitchEmoteProvider` singleton used by the emotes barrel; search here for Twitch API integration, auth token recovery, and emote transformation logic.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/ffmpeg.summary: FFmpeg-backed HLS download and recording helper for StreamFusion, with binary resolution, progress parsing, fallback output formats, and cancellation-aware process control. Exports `FfmpegUnavailableError`, `resolveFfmpegPath`, `parseFfmpegProgress`, `downloadHlsWithFfmpeg`, and `startHlsRecordingWithFfmpeg` for media capture and segment recording workflows.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/http-c.summary: Centralized retrying HTTP client for Twitch API/GQL traffic, built around per-origin queues, concurrency caps, keep-alive headers, circuit breaking, and request retries with backoff and jitter. Exports the `httpClient` singleton plus `RetryOptions`, and is the place to look for connection-exhaustion mitigation and transient-network handling.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/stream.summary: Parses an HLS master playlist into a normalized stream quality catalog, extracting resolution, frame rate, bitrate, and Source-vs-variant labels for recording UI selection. Also exports the quality chooser and fetcher used by the stream recording backend to discover and pick the best rendition for a given target quality.

Finalizes captured recording sections into a committed output file by assembling a concat manifest, running ffmpeg, hashing the artifact, and atomically moving the result into place with no-clobber fallback logic. Exports helpers for atomic commit, artifact identity verification, cleanup of temp section paths, and the section finalizer factory used by the recording pipeline.

Orchestrates the end-to-end stream recording workflow, including playback resolution, quality choice, recorder lifecycle, pause/resume/recovery, section tracking, and finalization handoff. This is the main service layer that wires together quality cataloging, section finalization, artifact probing, and session persistence for completed or interrupted recordings.

Persistence and validation layer for stream recording sessions, journals, snapshots, notices, and recovery states. It parses untrusted stored data into `StreamRecordingSessionStore`-compatible shapes, enforces recording path and section ownership rules, and bridges the backend storage service with session subscription updates.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/third-.summary: Electron network helper that removes `Set-Cookie` headers from selected Twitch, Kick, and emote CDN responses to suppress Chromium third-party cookie warnings. Exports URL predicates, header stripping, session registration, and cookie purge logic used during startup and for persistent partitions.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/twitch.summary: Live notification source that syncs Twitch follows to EventSub subscriptions and converts online/offline events into `LiveNotificationObservation` callbacks. Exports the `TwitchLiveEventSubSource` class plus coverage-degradation reporting for subscription failures and connection errors.

Electron session-level Twitch HLS manifest interceptor that rewrites `.m3u8` requests through VAFT-style ad removal before they reach the renderer. Key responsibilities include retrying manifest fetches, tracking per-channel stream state and ad-break state, and redirecting requests to processed data URLs for network-transparent ad blocking.

Safe Twitch playlist fetch helper that only allows `https://*.ttvnw.net/*.m3u8` URLs, follows a small bounded set of redirects, and aborts slow requests via per-request controllers. Exports `TwitchPlaylistFetchService` plus the singleton `twitchPlaylistFetchService`, which the Twitch streaming pipeline can use for cancellable playlist retrieval and error normalization.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/update.summary: Electron auto-update service built around `electron-updater` and `electron-store`, with persisted prerelease and auto-check settings plus a scheduler for hourly/daily/weekly polling. Exports `effectiveIntervalMs` for interval clamping and `initUpdateService` to wire updater events into renderer status/progress events and internal update state.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/vaft-p.summary: Service that fetches, parses, caches, and periodically refreshes Twitch ad-blocking patterns from the TwitchAdSolutions VAFT scripts. Exports a stateful singleton-style class with initialization, remote fetch, rate limiting, and Electron Store persistence for ad pattern updates used by the desktop app’s ad-detection pipeline.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/video-.summary: Factory that wires the default video download implementation for the desktop app, connecting Twitch/Kick VOD resolution, save-file dialogs, ffmpeg downloads, and queue management. This is the integration layer that builds a ready-to-use `VideoDownloadService` for platform-specific video export flows.

Core orchestration for HLS video downloads, taking a resolved playback URL and turning it into a queued download job with progress updates, destination tracking, and error handling. Exports the `VideoDownloadService` interface plus `createVideoDownloadService`, which composes platform playback resolution, save-path selection, and ffmpeg-backed HLS transfer into one serial download pipeline.

apps/desktop/src/backend/services/web-co.summary: Utility for polling an Electron `WebContents` until a DOM predicate becomes truthy instead of relying on fixed load delays. Exports `waitForWebContentsCondition`, a testable readiness helper used for SPA pages where `did-finish-load` fires before the content is actually rendered.

apps/desktop/src/backend/shutdown-marker.summary: Shutdown-sentinel helper that writes, checks, and clears a `.clean-shutdown` marker in Electron user data so startup code can detect whether the previous run exited cleanly. Exports `markCleanShutdown`, `wasCleanShutdown`, and `markSessionStarted`, and exists to avoid circular imports between main-process shutdown paths and window-manager crash handling.

apps/desktop/src/backend/utility/caption.summary: Worker-style utility process for local speech-to-text captioning, bootstrapping a Sherpa ONNX recognizer and streaming PCM audio chunks through a `LocalCaptionRecognizer`. It listens for `start`/`audio`/`stop` messages from the parent port and reports recognizer state back, fitting into the app’s local-captioning pipeline.

apps/desktop/src/components/auth/Profile.summary: Profile/account dropdown for the desktop app with Twitch and Kick connection state handling, logout actions, and channel navigation. Key pieces include `ProfileDropdown`, `SingleAvatar`, and `StackedAvatars`, plus outside-click dismissal and proxied avatar fallbacks for CDN quirks.

apps/desktop/src/components/auth/Reconne.summary: Storybook fixtures for the moderation reconnect dialog, preloading auth and reconnect store state so the component can be viewed in missing-scope, unknown-scope, and loading states. Useful when searching for Storybook setup that drives store-backed UI stories.

Modal that asks users to reconnect Twitch or Kick when moderator scopes are missing, mapping raw OAuth scopes to plain-language permission descriptions. Exports `ReconnectForModDialog` and coordinates login, token revalidation, and reconnect callbacks through the auth and reconnect stores.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/AGENTS..summary: Architecture guide for the chat UI area, describing ownership boundaries, entry points like `ChatPanel`, `ChatMessage`, and platform orchestrators, plus invariants for message shape, emote substitution, and Virtuoso keying. Developers should search this file when they need the rules for adding chat features, mod tooling, or platform-specific chat behavior.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/BitsHig.summary: Storybook stories for the Bits chat highlight card, showing Twitch and Kick context variants with sample cheering content. Helpful for finding the visual example of event highlight styling and platform-specific story args.

Memoized chat event wrapper for Twitch Bits cheers that renders a standardized highlight card with gem icon, purple accent, and platform-aware styling. Exports `BitsHighlight` and fits into the chat event highlight system via `ChatEventHighlightCard`.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/chat-se.summary: Pure utility for determining whether chat input can send, returning eligible/ineligible states with user-facing reasons like reconnecting, disabled, or sign-in required. Exports `resolveChatSendEligibility` plus shared reason constants used by compose UI and send-button gating logic.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/ChatMes.summary: Core chat-row renderer for Twitch/Kick messages, combining badges, emotes, mentions, moderation highlights, reply/pin actions, and deleted-message display logic. It defines helpers for badge ordering, fragment keys, mention matching, and timestamp formatting so the message item stays stable inside virtualized chat lists.

Shared Tailwind class constants for the hover action cluster, circular action buttons, and Twitch-style tooltip styling used by chat message controls. Centralizes the visual pattern for pin/reply/moderation buttons so multiple chat components stay consistent.

Storybook fixture for the virtualized chat message list, seeding mocked chat stores and rendering Twitch, Kick, and empty-channel scenarios. Useful for finding the list component, channel-specific behavior, and callback wiring in isolation.

Virtualized chat timeline that reads channel messages from the chat store, tracks pause/scroll behavior, and renders a `ChatMessage` row per item with stable callback refs. It also inserts the "New messages" divider and handles bottom-follow logic for live streams.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/ChatPan.summary: Storybook entry for the top-level chat panel, with auth store state forced into a guest/offline setup to preview the empty Twitch panel shell. Helps developers find the container that chooses between Twitch and Kick chat implementations.

Top-level chat container that lazily initializes emote providers and switches between `KickChat` and `TwitchChat` based on the selected platform. It acts as the integration point for platform-specific chat setup, channel IDs, and Kick badge/catalog props.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/ChatPin.summary: Storybook showcase for the chat pin action button, rendered in isolation with a mocked click handler. Useful for finding the Twitch-style hover action button and verifying tooltip/button visuals.

Reusable pin-action button for chat messages, built with the shared Twitch action button and tooltip styles. Exports the `ChatPinButton` component plus an inline SVG pin icon, and is used by message hover controls when pinning is allowed.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/Context.summary: Context-sensitive emote suggestion row for chat composition, triggered by the token under the cursor and backed by the emote store. Exports `getContextualEmoteMatch`, `useContextualEmoteMode`, and `ContextualEmoteRow`; it filters by platform/provider, ranks matches, handles keyboard selection, and surfaces loading/no-results/fallback states for Twitch and Kick emote autocomplete.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/Deleted.summary: Storybook fixture for the high-level deleted-message moderation component, with compact, cozy, and audit variants seeded from chat story stores. Useful for finding the wrapper that composes badges, moderator attribution, and deleted-content presentation for moderation UI.

Top-level deleted-message renderer that assembles sender and moderator attribution, badge truncation, timestamp formatting, and mode-specific audit details before delegating to compact or cozy layouts. Exports `DeletedMessageHighlight`, which is the main integration point for chat moderation highlights across Twitch and Kick.

Storybook scenarios for the compact deleted-message card, covering compact, audit, and message-only states. Helps developers find the minimal card layout used by the moderation highlight system and how its props map to rendered sender/moderator content.

Compact deleted-message card built on `ChatEventHighlightCard`, with a trash icon, red accent, and three display modes: full message, compact summary, and audit detail. This is the lower-level layout used by `DeletedMessageHighlight` when the app wants a denser moderation event presentation.

Storybook coverage for the cozy deleted-message variant, showing compact, audit, and message-only modes. Use this to find the roomier moderation presentation and the prop contract shared with the top-level deleted-message wrapper.

Roomier deleted-message card built on `ChatHighlightCard`, using a bordered container and the same message/compact/audit modes as the compact version. Exports `DeletedMessageHighlightCozy`, which `DeletedMessageHighlight` selects when the cozy moderation style is requested.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/EmoteIm.summary: Storybook examples for the `EmoteImage` component, including loaded, animated, deferred skeleton, and compact variants. Helps developers find the image renderer used throughout chat for emote display, click handling, lazy loading, and placeholder states.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/InfoBan.summary: Chat-room status banner that collapses active moderation/mode restrictions into one visible label with a tooltip list, using `useChatRoomState` plus a precedence order for Twitch/Kick chat modes like followers-only, verification, subscribers-only, account age, emote-only, slow mode, unique chat, and shield mode. Exports `InfoBanner` and local SVG icons; developers will search this file for chat mode display logic, room-state-to-UI mapping, and tooltip precedence.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/input/N.summary: Storybook scenarios for `NativeEmoteButton`, covering Twitch and Kick variants, an open picker state, and a disabled state with seeded chat stores. Useful when searching for component demos, story fixtures, and platform-specific emote-picker behavior in the chat input.

Platform-aware chat input button that opens the native emote picker and coordinates with `EmotePickerPopover`, including Kick fallback emote rendering, hover reroll behavior, and optional subscription gating. Exports `NativeEmoteButton` as the trigger/control for native Twitch and Kick emote selection, and developers will find popover anchoring, channel avatar lookup, and hover-state logic here.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/input/Q.summary: Storybook coverage for `QuickEmoteActionBar`, showing Twitch recents, Kick recents, and disabled behavior inside a fixed-width chat input mock. Search this file for the action-bar visual test cases and store seeding used to preview recent/global emote shortcuts.

Compact emote shortcut strip that pulls recent and global emotes from the store, filters them by platform/provider, caps the list, and animates reflow when the set changes. Exports `QuickEmoteActionBar`; this is the file to find for recent-emote ranking, provider filtering, layout animation, and the chat input's quick-pick row.

apps/desktop/src/components/chat/input/T.summary: Storybook scenarios for `ThirdPartyEmoteButton`, including Twitch, Kick, open-picker, and disabled variants, all mounted in the same chat-input shell as the native picker stories.
