It exports `startDevRelayHost` and `bootstrapDevRelayHost`, which connect the relay socket to `window.electronAPI` and tear the host bridge down when the socket closes.

apps/desktop/src/dev-relay/moderation-br.summary: Provides development-only moderation and auth fixtures driven by the `moderationFixture` query parameter. It exports helpers for selecting a fixture, mutating auth/dev override stores, and intercepting moderation/auth RPC paths so the browser can simulate history, empty states, errors, reconnects, and timeout flows for moderation UI testing.

apps/desktop/src/dev-relay/protocol.ts.summary: Defines the JSON message protocol for the dev relay, including call/subscribe/result/event/unsubscribe message shapes. It exports `encodeRelayMessage`, `decodeRelayMessage`, and `serializeRelayError`, making this the place to look for relay wire format and error normalization.

apps/desktop/src/dev-relay/relay-host.ts.summary: Implements the host-side RPC bridge that receives relay messages and invokes methods on the Electron API object. It resolves dotted method paths defensively, supports one-way subscriptions with cleanup, and serializes failures back to the browser client, so this file is the core of the relay host dispatch logic.

apps/desktop/src/dev-relay/relay-rpc-cli.summary: Implements the browser-side RPC client for the dev relay, translating method calls and subscriptions into WebSocket messages. It exports `createRelayRpcClient`, tracks pending calls by ID, converts relay errors back into `Error` objects, and feeds subscription events to listeners.

apps/desktop/src/dev-relay/user-profile-.summary: Returns development-only failure fixtures for user profile reads when `userProfileFixture=unavailable` is present in the URL. It exports `getUserProfileFixture`, which matches `userProfiles.*` paths and forces typed failure states for profile identity lookups and other profile fields.

apps/desktop/src/dev-relay/websocket.ts.summary: Creates and retries the development relay WebSocket connection used by both browser and host relay bootstraps. It exports `createDevRelayWebSocket` and `waitForRelaySocket`, providing role-tagged `/__streamfusion-dev` connections plus retry/backoff behavior until the relay comes up.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/browse-sn.summary: Bootstraps TanStack Query caches from persisted browse snapshots in Electron storage, restoring top streams, categories, category streams, search results, followed streams, and related chat/history LRU state on app startup. It gates hydration by snapshot identity and freshness, fills missing query data with the shared `STREAM_KEYS`/`CATEGORY_KEYS`/`SEARCH_KEYS`, and prewarms viewport images to make browse routes feel instant after cold launch.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/cache-inv.summary: Tests the cache invalidation surface for follow mutations, account removal, and platform recovery, verifying the exact React Query keys that are invalidated or removed. It protects the split between follow/channel caches, followed stream caches, and recovery refresh behavior while also checking cache-performance telemetry labels.

Centralizes React Query invalidation and removal logic for follow-related and platform-recovery events, so auth changes and mutations only touch the affected cache families. Exports helpers for follow mutation invalidation, platform account cache removal, and selective stream recovery refresh using `CHANNEL_KEYS`, `STREAM_KEYS`, and `FOLLOWED_CONTENT_KEYS`.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/cache-per.summary: Covers cache-performance telemetry for query surfaces, asserting the 50ms budget rules, p95 aggregation, invalidation dispatch timing, and hook-driven paint/refresh instrumentation. The tests document how `useQueryCachePerformance` distinguishes cache-hit paint from route refresh start and ensure performance samples are recorded against the correct surface labels.

React Query cache instrumentation hook and helpers for measuring cache-hit paint, route refresh start, and cache invalidation latency against a 50ms budget. Exports the `useQueryCachePerformance` hook plus sampling/summary/reset utilities, and attaches a `window.__streamfusionCachePerformance` debug target for dev inspection.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/cache-pol.summary: Vitest coverage for the app-data cache policy matrix, verifying that different surfaces map to distinct TTL, refetch, and storage tiers. This test file protects `APP_DATA_CACHE_POLICIES` and `getQueryCacheOptions` from collapsing remote browsing data and persisted local state into one generic cache strategy.

Central cache-policy registry for TanStack Query, defining per-surface stale times, GC times, polling intervals, and whether previous data should be kept. Exports `APP_DATA_CACHE_POLICIES`, `AppDataCachePolicyName`, and `getQueryCacheOptions` to translate domain-specific cache tiers into query options.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/persisted.summary: Persistent LRU cache for channel metadata backed by `window.electronAPI.store`, keyed by platform and normalized username. Exports hydration, lookup, save, reset, and React subscription hooks for reusing validated Twitch/Kick channel snapshots while enforcing entry count, size, and age limits.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/useCatego.summary: React Query hook for loading category-scoped Twitch and Kick media, normalizing clips/videos into one shared shape and merging results across platforms. It handles category identity validation, IPC fetching, deduping, sort direction, time-range filtering, and cache policy wiring for category detail/search views.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/useChanne.summary: Channel query hooks and key builders for fetching followed channels and channel details by username from the Electron backend. It deduplicates channel identities, logs soft failures for followed lists, and feeds cache-performance instrumentation used by following and stream-detail surfaces.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/useFollow.summary: Query helpers for assembling followed videos and clips across a user’s channels, with normalization of heterogeneous backend payloads into a single feed item model. It limits fan-out, filters invalid past videos, deduplicates by platform and id, and supports recent/views sorting plus clip time ranges.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/useHistor.summary: Local history query and mutation helpers backed by the history store, exposing a React Query view of in-app playback/history state. It keeps the query cache in sync when items are added, removed, or cleared and measures cache invalidation dispatches for performance tracking.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/useInfini.summary: Infinite-query hooks for paginated stream lists, covering top streams, category streams, and followed streams via Electron IPC. It standardizes cursor-based pagination, wires cache policies/performance logging, and enables category search when a numeric category id is unavailable but a guessed name exists.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/useSearch.summary: React Query hooks for remote search across channels, categories, and unified results in the desktop app, backed by `window.electronAPI` search IPC. Defines `SEARCH_KEYS`, handles cursor-based infinite pagination, abort-stale-request protection, and query cache performance instrumentation for search dropdown and global search flows.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/useStream.summary: React Query hooks for stream discovery data, including top streams, category streams, followed streams, and channel-specific stream details. Exposes `STREAM_KEYS` and standardizes Electron IPC fetching, cache policy integration, logging for failed followed-stream fetches, and non-retrying offline-safe stream lookups.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/use-ad-element-ob.summary: MutationObserver-based hook that detects and hides Twitch ad DOM elements as they appear, including overlay and banner selectors. Intended for player-side ad suppression, with cleanup and debug logging of every hidden element and total hidden count.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/use-app-shutdown..summary: App shutdown hook that subscribes to the main-process `app:before-quit` event and forces fast renderer cleanup. It shuts down chat services, marks `window.__shuttingDown`, and clears batched chat state so expensive teardown work does not outlive the process.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/use-chat-replay.t.summary: Stateful chat replay hook that fetches a replay window for a video playback position, caches recent results, deduplicates in-flight requests, and cancels stale IPC work when subscribers drop to zero. Provides `retry` plus `loading`/`ready`/`error` status for chat playback sync and replay-window lookup flows.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/use-download-acti.summary: Convenience hook for starting clip and video downloads from the UI, with duplicate-queue detection before enqueueing. Wraps Electron download IPC, shows success/error toasts, and prompts the user when the same source is already present in Downloads.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/use-live-notifica.summary: Bridge hook that listens for live stream notifications from Electron and pushes them into app state and toast UI. It also handles "open" actions by navigating directly to the stream route, making it the glue between notification delivery, auth preferences, and router navigation.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/use-stream-record.summary: React hook that wraps the `window.electronAPI.streamRecording` bridge with start, pause, resume, stop, recovery, and reveal/open actions for desktop stream recording. It centralizes toast-based error handling and is the main action surface for the stream recording UI when searching for Electron bridge calls, recovery flows, or recording controls.

Context-backed React store and provider for stream recording lifecycle state, translating backend snapshots into UI phases like idle, active, completed, partial, failed, and interrupted. It also exports screen-reader announcers for lifecycle and quality changes, making it the state subscription layer for recording status and accessibility messaging.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useAfterFirstPain.summary: Small React hook that returns `true` only after the first browser paint, using `requestAnimationFrame` and a test-mode shortcut. Use it when looking for post-hydration or deferred-render gating in the UI.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useAuth.ts.summary: Collection of auth and profile hooks built on the auth store for Twitch, Kick, guest mode, follows, preferences, and auth errors. This file is the main search target for authentication state selectors, login/logout actions, combined status helpers, and user identity display logic.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useChatRoomState..summary: Reads optimistic chat room state for a given platform and channel from `useRoomStateStore`, falling back to `DEFAULT_ROOM_STATE` when no entry exists. It is the hook to find if you need room-state lookup by `platform + channelId` without null checks, especially for chat moderation or channel settings UI.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useChatSettingsSy.summary: Test-only helper module exposing inspection and reset utilities for `useChatSettingsSync` internals like the in-flight guard and provenance map. Use this file when searching for hook test helpers, module-scoped state reset, or debug access that must not ship in production bundles.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/persisted.summary: Persistence layer for React Query infinite search results, keyed by normalized query, platform, limit, and live-only state. Hydrates from Electron store, validates and sanitizes saved UnifiedCategory/UnifiedChannel/UnifiedClip/UnifiedVideo pages, and exposes save/get/use hooks so search screens can restore cached results across sessions.

Generic persisted snapshot helper for restoring a single UI result set from Electron storage by serialized identity and age limit. Exports load/save hooks plus a React hook that rehydrates state and optionally prewarms viewport images, making it useful for browse-like views that need instant resume behavior.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/recent-st.summary: Caches a small LRU-like index of recently viewed stream image URLs per platform and channel, then prewarms those images on later visits. Exports rememberRecentStreamImages, prewarmRecentStreamImages, and useRecentStreamImagePrewarm, which together reduce blank thumbnails and improve perceived speed in stream browsing flows.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/queries/useCatego.summary: React Query hooks for category discovery and category metadata, with merged Twitch/Kick handling and viewer-count aggregation. Exports CATEGORY_KEYS, useCategoryMetadata, and useTopCategories, and the file anchors the category browsing/search flow by deduplicating cross-platform categories and caching per-category tag lookups.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useChatSettingsSy.summary: Chat settings synchronization hook that merges Twitch/Kick room-state sources into a single last-write-wins store entry. It exports `useChatSettingsSync`, the `chatSettingsToPatch` translator, and internal test helpers (`inFlight`, `__debugProvenance`) used to verify fetch, websocket, and optimistic update races in the room-state sync pipeline.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts.summary: Minimal debounce hook that delays propagating a changing value until a timeout expires. Commonly used for search inputs, filters, and other high-frequency UI state that should not trigger immediate downstream work.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useElectron.ts.summary: React hook collection for talking to Electron's preload bridge, including app version, prerelease metadata, window controls, external links, notifications, and persisted store access. It centralizes renderer-to-main process integration through `window.electronAPI` for desktop-specific behavior.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useHelixPoll.ts.summary: Visibility-aware polling hook for Helix-style endpoints that fetches immediately, then refreshes on an interval only while enabled and the document is visible. It exports `useHelixPoll` plus typed options/result shapes for building polling flows with loading/error state and manual refresh.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useInterval.ts.summary: Declarative interval hook that repeatedly invokes the latest callback without recreating the timer on every render. Used as the reusable timer primitive for polling and other recurring React side effects that need pause/resume semantics.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useIsKickMod.ts.summary: Permission-check hook that determines whether the current authenticated Kick user can moderate a channel, with broadcaster self-moderation, cached moderated-channel lookup, and dev override support. This is the Kick-side gate for showing mod UI without triggering any network hydrate.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useIsTwitchMod.ts.summary: Permission-check hook for Twitch moderation that returns true when the signed-in user is the broadcaster, is in the cached moderated-channel set, or has the dev override enabled. It is read-only and depends on `useAuthStore`, `useModeratedChannelsStore`, and `useDevModOverrideStore` to gate mod-only UI.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useManagedTimeout.summary: Managed one-shot timeout hook that exposes imperative `start` and `clear` controls while keeping the latest callback and cleaning up on unmount. Useful for auto-hide, re-arming delays, and other resettable timeout workflows in interactive desktop UI.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useSearchHistory..summary: React hook for per-scope search history persistence in `localStorage`, with migration support for legacy flat arrays and capped, de-duplicated recent terms. Exposes `useSearchHistory` plus `SEARCH_HISTORY_SCOPES` for channels, categories, and streams search UIs that need scoped autocomplete or recent-query dropdowns.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useStickyDismisse.summary: React hook that implements a sticky-dismiss suppression gate for live prediction banners, preventing the same prediction ID from reopening after the user closes it. Exports `useStickyDismissedPrediction` for chat/player widgets that need to ignore repeated status updates until a new prediction arrives.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useStreamPlayback.summary: Playback URL cache and fetch orchestration for stream players, including prefetching, shared subscription ref-counting, deferred eviction, staggered initialization, and retry/failure backoff. Used by the main player and mini-player to avoid duplicate backend IPC calls and to keep Twitch/Kick stream playback URLs fresh.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useTimeout.ts.summary: Minimal declarative timer hook that runs the latest callback once after a delay and cleans up on delay changes or unmount. Useful anywhere the codebase needs a one-shot timeout without managing `setTimeout` and refs manually.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useUpdater.ts.summary: Updater state hook that bridges the renderer to the Electron updater backend, wiring initial status, progress, and status-change subscriptions into app state. Exposes actions for checking, downloading, installing, and toggling prerelease or auto-check settings, making it the main updater facade for settings and update dialogs.

apps/desktop/src/lib/api-client.ts.summary: Shared Ky-based HTTP client wrapper with centralized retry, timeout, and error logging behavior for frontend API calls. Exports a thin `api` facade for `get`, `post`, `put`, `delete`, and `patch` so network code can reuse one consistent request pipeline.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useModerationAuth.summary: React hook that resolves whether the current user is authorized to moderate a Twitch or Kick channel, including broadcaster vs moderator roles, stale-proof expiry, and dev fixture overrides. Exports `useModerationAuthority`, `MODERATION_AUTHORITY_FRESH_MS`, and authority state types used by moderation UIs to gate actions, reconnect prompts, and verification flows.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useModLog.ts.summary: React Query hook for reading moderation history from the renderer-side `window.electronAPI.modLog` bridge, with development fixtures, filter-based query keys, and retry support after write actions. Exports `useModLog` and `ModLogEntry` for mod dashboards that need searchable audit logs and read-after-write refreshes.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus..summary: Small browser-network hook that tracks online/offline state from `navigator.onLine` plus a custom debug override event. Exports `useNetworkStatus` and `setNetworkStatusOverrideForDebug`, making it useful for connectivity banners, retry UI, and offline-state testing.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/usePlatformHealth.summary: Renderer hook that hydrates platform health from `electronAPI.platformHealth`, subscribes to live status changes, and computes an `anyDegraded` aggregate flag. Used by app surfaces that need Twitch/Kick service health, recovery cache invalidation, and status-page details.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useRequireModScop.summary: Hook that checks whether the signed-in Twitch token has the OAuth scopes needed for mod actions and exposes `promptReconnect()` to open the re-consent dialog. Fits the moderation flow as a lazy scope gate for pin/unpin and other privileged actions, with dev overrides for local testing.

apps/desktop/src/hooks/useResolveTwitchC.summary: React Query hook that resolves a Twitch `broadcaster_login` into a numeric broadcaster ID via Helix `/users?login=` and returns loading, null, or resolved channel data. Supports a dev override for fixed broadcaster IDs so `/mod/twitch/<login>` and related mod pages can mount without a live Twitch session.

apps/desktop/src/lib/stream-route-preloa.summary: Preload and startup-warmup helper for the Stream route and its nested chat module in the desktop app. Exports `preloadStreamExperience()` for intent-based route prefetching and `scheduleStreamExperienceStartupPrewarm()` for a one-shot post-first-paint `requestAnimationFrame` warmup with status markers on `window.__streamExperiencePrewarm`.

apps/desktop/src/lib/utils.ts.summary: Shared desktop utility module for class name merging, stream metadata formatting, and cross-platform category normalization. Exports `cn`, `formatViewerCount`, `formatDuration`, `formatLanguageLabel`, `normalizeCategoryName`, `getEquivalentCategoryName`, `pickWinner`, and `formatUptime`, and it centralizes Twitch/Kick naming equivalences plus date/time parsing fallbacks.

apps/desktop/src/lib/viewport-image-prew.summary: Viewport image prewarming queue that resolves proxied image URLs, loads them with bounded concurrency, and retains recently warmed `HTMLImageElement`s to keep image-heavy feeds responsive. Exports `prewarmViewportImages()` plus test helpers to reset state and inspect retained URLs, with constants controlling queue size, concurrency, and retention.

apps/desktop/src/main.ts.summary: Electron main-process entry point for the StreamFusion desktop app, wiring app startup, dev/prod runtime configuration, logging, protocols, IPC, and service initialization. This is the file to search for window lifecycle, CDP remote debugging, net logging, auth/protocol registration, and backend service bootstrapping.

apps/desktop/src/lib/cross-logger.ts.summary: Cross-process logging adapter for code shared between Electron main and renderer without pulling `electron-log` into the renderer bundle. Exports a `logger` with `debug/info/warn/error` plus `setMainLogSink` so calls can route to the main logger, the renderer IPC bridge, or console fallback during boot and tests.

apps/desktop/src/lib/dev-browser-media-u.summary: URL rewrite helpers for the dev browser media proxy used in local playback and media inspection. Exports `DEV_BROWSER_MEDIA_PATH`, `buildDevBrowserMediaUrl`, and rewrite helpers that convert Twitch clip/media URLs and nested playback values into proxied dev-server URLs.

apps/desktop/src/lib/duration.ts.summary: Flexible duration parser that accepts seconds, colon-delimited time strings, and `h/m/s` unit syntax. Exports `parseDurationSeconds` for turning user-entered duration strings into positive second counts, returning `null` for invalid input.

apps/desktop/src/lib/error-toast.ts.summary: Standardized error toast helper built on `sonner` with copy-to-clipboard support. Exports `showErrorToast`, which shows a longer-lived error notification and adds a "Copy error" action for faster bug reporting.

apps/desktop/src/lib/id-utils.ts.summary: Platform-aware identity helpers for Twitch/Kick channels and streams, designed to avoid key collisions and dedupe duplicates across inconsistent API IDs. Exports key builders like `getChannelKey`, `getStreamKey`, `getStreamElementKey`, `getChannelNameKey`, plus `channelsMatch` and `dedupeChannelsByIdentity` for equality checks and merge logic.

apps/desktop/src/lib/languages.ts.summary: Static broadcaster language list and display-name resolver for Twitch/Kick filter UIs. Exports `BROADCAST_LANGUAGES` and `getLanguageDisplayName`, using `Intl.DisplayNames` to turn ISO 639-1 codes into human-readable labels.

apps/desktop/src/lib/live-notification-i.summary: Helpers for normalizing live-notification usernames and choosing a stable display name from multiple candidates. Exports `normalizeLiveNotificationUsername` and `resolveLiveNotificationDisplayName`, which match names case-insensitively and prefer a non-raw display label when available.

apps/desktop/src/lib/live-notification-p.summary: Per-channel live alert preference logic that merges defaults, checks platform toggles, and determines whether a channel should receive notifications. Exports helpers for channel keys, preference normalization, eligibility checks, per-channel updates, and platform-field mapping.

apps/desktop/src/lib/managed-interval.ts.summary: Backend-safe wrapper around `setInterval` that returns an idempotent stop handle and optionally unrefs the timer. Exports `createManagedInterval`, used as the sanctioned recurring timer abstraction for Electron main/Node code.

apps/desktop/src/lib/proxied-image-url.t.summary: Image URL allowlist and proxy resolver for Twitch/Kick avatars, previews, and other remote images. Exports `isAllowedPlatformImageUrl`, `resolveProxiedImageSrc`, `resolveProxiedSrc`, and related scheme constants so the app can safely rewrite supported platform images through a proxy or dev browser media endpoint.

apps/desktop/src/lib/settings-toast.ts.summary: Single stable success toast for settings auto-save flows. Exports `notifySettingsSaved`, which deduplicates rapid updates by reusing a fixed toast ID so sliders and other live settings do not spam the user.

apps/desktop/src/lib/sleep.ts.summary: Minimal promise-based delay helper for imperative async waits such as retry backoff. Exports `sleep`, the sanctioned `setTimeout` wrapper for code that truly needs elapsed time instead of an observable signal.

apps/desktop/src/lib/stream-recording-pr.summary: Presentation-layer labels and duration formatting for stream recording status UI. Exports phase/lifecycle label maps and `formatCapturedDuration` to turn recording state and elapsed seconds into human-readable text.

apps/desktop/src/pages/AGENTS.md.summary: Directory-level guide for route page components in the desktop app. Documents the TanStack Router page structure, page responsibilities, store/IPC boundaries, and anti-patterns to search when wiring route-level UI like Home, SearchResults, Stream, Video, and Settings.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Categories/index..summary: Categories landing page that fetches the full category list through `useTopCategories`, filters it client-side by text search, and renders it through a virtualized grid for performance. This is the route component to find when looking for category browsing, search filtering, or the `VirtualizedCategoryGrid` page wrapper.

apps/desktop/src/pages/CategoryDetail/co.summary: Reusable category media tab that loads category-specific clips or videos across Twitch and Kick via `useCategoryMedia`, shows loading/error/empty states, and opens a clip playback dialog when a clip is selected. It adapts backend media records into the shared `VideoOrClip` card shape used by stream related-content components.

apps/desktop/src/pages/CategoryDetail/in.summary: Category detail route for browsing one game/category across Twitch and Kick, including cross-platform category matching, infinite stream pagination, tag/language filtering, and viewer-count aggregation. This is the entry point for the dual-platform stream browser and IntersectionObserver-driven load-more flow used by the category detail page.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Downloads/index.t.summary: Standalone `DownloadsPage` React screen for a media-download queue, showing active vs completed items with progress bars, status badges, and action buttons like pause, resume, and show in folder. Uses mocked download data and UI primitives (`Button`, `Progress`) to model video/clip download management in the desktop app.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Following/index.t.summary: `FollowingPage` is the main discovery/feed screen for followed live streams, videos, clips, categories, and channels across Twitch and Kick. It combines local follows, remote query data, search/filter/sort state, cache invalidation, and preloading logic to build a deduplicated followed-content dashboard.

apps/desktop/src/pages/History/index.tsx.summary: `HistoryPage` renders watch history and routes each entry back to the right video, clip, or stream page, with deletion and clear-history actions. It also verifies playback availability through `electronAPI`, resolves clip metadata and playback URLs, and opens a clip dialog when users replay past items.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Home/components/l.summary: Home-page section component that renders the "Live Channels" block using `StreamGrid`, taking a `streams` list plus loading state and showing an 8-item skeleton grid while data is fetching. Search for this file when working on the featured/home browse layout or the stream-card grid that surfaces live content.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Home/index.tsx.summary: Top-level `HomePage` route for the desktop app, wiring `useTopStreams` into a featured-stream hero, a live-now section, and a browse-categories CTA. Handles the empty/error state for stream loading and defers rendering until after first paint to reduce layout jank on initial load.

apps/desktop/src/pages/index.ts.summary: Central page barrel that lazy-loads all route pages with `React.lazy` for code-splitting and smaller initial bundles. This is the place to find the app's page entry points and route-level component exports such as home, categories, search, stream, settings, history, downloads, and moderation pages.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Mod/AGENTS.md.summary: Documentation for the moderation admin surface under `/mod`, describing the page layout, platform coverage, invariants, and anti-patterns for Twitch and Kick moderation flows. Use this as the map for moderation routing, retention settings, mod-log access, and the channel-level component tree.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Mod/channel/Chann.summary: Single-channel banned-user list for the moderation console, with Twitch Helix fetching, inline unban mutations, optimistic row removal, and per-row busy state. On Kick it intentionally renders an informational note because the platform has no public banned-users endpoint, making this a key file for banned-list and unban workflows.

Channel-level engagement panel that shows the active Twitch prediction and poll for a broadcaster, replacing the older cross-channel aggregate view. Broadcaster-facing moderators roster for a Twitch channel, with an add-user username lookup, moderator list fetch, and add/remove flows wired to Helix moderation mutations. Exports `ChannelModeratorsTable` and fits into the `/mod` channel admin page by keeping local moderator state in sync with the moderated-channels store and Twitch auth tokens.

Standalone mod-log feed for a channel, mirroring the in-chat moderation history tab but without the user popout dependency. Exports `ChannelModLogFeed` and provides action/username filters, incremental paging, timestamp formatting, and verified/error/partial states via `useModLog`.

Channel moderation panel for reviewing Twitch unban requests with status filtering and approve/deny resolution flow. Exports `ChannelUnbanRequests` and coordinates Helix fetch/patch calls, pending-confirmation UI, and optional resolution text for moderators with access.

Broadcaster-only Twitch VIP management table for a channel, with Helix-backed loading plus add/remove actions keyed by username or user id. It resolves logins to Twitch users, calls the VIP mutation helpers, and fits into the mod channel shell as the roster UI for viewing and editing the first 100 VIPs.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Mod/channel/ModCh.summary: Route wrapper for `/mod/kick/$channel` that reads the channel slug from TanStack Router and passes it into the shared mod-channel page. This keeps Kick and Twitch channel moderation flows on the same shell while differing only by platform and route param shape.

Shared per-channel moderation dashboard shell for Twitch and Kick, responsible for resolving the channel identity, checking moderation authority, and rendering the channel-scoped sections. It ties together retention controls, mod-log history, banned users, VIPs, moderators, unban requests, and engagement tools under one route-driven page.

Route wrapper for `/mod/twitch/$channel` that extracts the Twitch broadcaster login from the URL and forwards it to the shared mod-channel page. It exists to keep platform-specific routing thin while the core moderation UI stays centralized.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Mod/channel/Reten.summary: Reusable retention settings card for a single moderation-log scope, with a days input and Forever toggle persisted through `window.electronAPI.retention`. It is used by the per-channel moderation pages and other retention UIs to edit channel-scoped or global log-retention rules.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Mod/ChannelList.t.summary: Moderation landing-page component that enumerates channels the signed-in user can moderate and links each one into the per-channel mod routes. It pulls Twitch moderated channels from the Helix moderation API, bridges the broadcaster's own channel, and also includes the signed-in Kick channel, making it the file to search for mod-channel discovery, channel cards, and platform-specific moderation entry points.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Mod/GlobalRetenti.summary: Wrapper around the shared retention card for the global mod-log retention default shown on the /mod index. Use this file when searching for the global-vs-channel retention UI or the default retention scope that per-channel pages override.

apps/desktop/src/pages/Mod/index.tsx.summary: Top-level /mod moderation page that assembles the channel list, refresh action, and global retention section into one dashboard. It is the entry point for moderation navigation and triggers a store hydrate so new moderator access appears without a full reload.

apps/desktop/src/pages/MultiStream/index.summary: MultiStream workspace page that wires the stream grid, layout toggles, add-stream dialog, and optional chat rail into a single responsive view. Vitest coverage for Kick video listing endpoint mapping and pagination, including Electron `net.fetch` mocking, cursor handling, deleted/pruned/private filtering, subscriber-only inference, and request URL construction. Vitest suite for Twitch stream endpoint wrappers covering user-based stream lookup, followed streams, top streams, and direct login search. Contract tests for the Twitch chat replay source parser and fetcher, covering video-offset lookup, cursor pagination, and failure classification for empty, unsupported, transient, auth, and rate-limit responses. Unit tests for the Twitch client facade that wrap GQL and Helix endpoint fallbacks, with coverage for platform identity, stream lookup, top-stream pagination mapping, and error-tolerant delegation. Vitest tests for the Twitch API requestor wrapper that centralizes authenticated Helix requests, token refresh, retry/backoff, and platform-health instrumentation.
